item.title: PortWin 1.17
item.description:
• System Check (sidebar and File menu): checks Rosetta 2, the Wine engine, disk space, memory and download servers, with a one-click fix for each problem
  • When you open a Windows file, PortWin asks which bottle to use — or creates a new one
  • High Resolution (Retina) mode per bottle: sharp text and interfaces in Windows programs
  • Report a Problem (Help menu): sends a report with logs to the developer in one click
  • Windows components (Visual C++, .NET, DirectX, fonts) now download from PortWin's own fast mirror, and the most common ones are fetched in advance over Wi-Fi
  • New recipes: Microsoft Office 2010–2016, 1C:Enterprise 8.3 and GOG offline game installers — choose your installer, setup.exe or ISO image, and PortWin does the rest
